recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: clear autumn night over san francisco, ten degrees and still
tilde characters hiding in forgotten file paths
a new breed of borrow checking for memory-safe code
ancient dna rewriting scandinavia's first harvest
monsoon waters claiming bridges in the himalayas

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Drag scrambled directory nodes into the correct tree before a rogue tilde expands and swallows the filesystem — each round is one folder hierarchy coming undone.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Clearing a tangled path tree in under a minute feels like finally fixing a broken shortcut.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Paths grow longer, tildes multiply, and nodes start auto-drifting toward wrong parents.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal phosphor green on black, autumn cursor blink

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Rhythm-tap borrow and return beats as ownership pulses through a living memory graph — miss a handoff and leaks bloom across the screen.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Perfect streaks collapse the graph into a single clean block — satisfying compiler-dopamine in thirty seconds.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Tempo climbs, dual ownership lanes open, and ghost references appear off-beat.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe rust compiler, pulsing ownership arcs

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Hold to gather frost on autumn branches, release to shake heirloom seeds into furrows before dawn freeze — physics decides where each cluster lands.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Watching seeds arc and nestle into fertile patches is a tiny harvest ritual.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Wind stiffens, frost line creeps down from the top, and fewer furrows stay open.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout scandinavian farm scroll, muted ochre and slate

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe between three mountain lanes as monsoon runoff rises — collect stranded travelers and dodge collapsing bridge debris before the pass floods.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Each rescued cluster chains into a combo counter that fills the valley with light.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Water level climbs, lanes narrow, and debris falls in unpredictable patterns.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor himalayan pass at dusk, ink-wash floodlines
